name: com.jfcartier.collider-event-system
description: Component-based collider/condition-driven event system: attach ordered Condition and Action components to a GameObject to build zone triggers (ColliderEvent) or continuously-evaluated watchers (ConditionWatcher).

samples.description: A walkable scene demonstrating Conditions, Actions, and Variables together. Materials are authored for URP - on Built-in RP, run Window > Rendering > Render Pipeline Converter first.
